newsitem.title: GERMANY: German autobahns offer drivers anti-stress therapy.
newsitem.headline: German autobahns offer drivers anti-stress therapy.

text.p: As Germans head south in their droves for summer holidays, motorway service stations have hired teams of sport and nutrition experts to help drivers beat the stress of hours on the road.

Experts will be on hand at selected service stations to give tips on food and exercises to drivers pounding hundreds of kilometres down Germany's autobahns in search of sun, sea and relaxation in southern Europe.

"Leading nutrition and sport scientists have compiled an up-to-date food and exercise plan, to help make long car journeys stress- and exhaustion-free," the German "Fit on the Road" campaign said in a statement on Thursday.

Drivers will be able to seek advice from special fitness teams, who will offer personalised eating and exercise tips with the aid of a special computer programme under the campaign run by government-owned service stations.
